name: Robert Capa
notes: Five plates in the catalog (count verified by grep this session, 2026-05-02): photo-0023 (Marriage, Czechoslovakia), photo-0118 (Land, USSR), photo-0131 (Land, USSR), photo-0246 (Food, USSR), photo-0274 (Ring Around the Rosy, Israel). Magnum Photos co-founder (1947) with Henri Cartier-Bresson, William Vandivert, David Seymour, and George Rodger; Magnum president 1952–1954. His brother Cornell Capa would later found the International Fund for Concerned Photography in his memory in 1966 (per src-icp-1966-concerned-photography-fund-institutional, in repo).
